svg.title: Su–Wood: the same geometry at every time
svg.desc: Exact m=3 profile surface, projected from C2. A large view and three identical time panels. The full stationary special Lagrangian is a three-manifold in C3, reconstructed by a circle action. These projected surfaces are not surface mean curvature flows.

g.text: Exact profile surface · m = 3 · μ₁ = μ₂ = 1 · φ = 0
Projection (Im Z, Re W, Im W) = (p, p sinh b, b)
Same camera, scale, crop and marked point at t = −2, 0, 2.
Color: arg Z, from blue (negative) to orange (positive). Re Z = cosh b is omitted.
A profile of a 3-manifold in C³; not a surface MCF in R³. Su–Wood (31).
